topics.title: Anthropic files for a Nasdaq IPO targeting up to a $2 trillion valuation
topics.why: It would be one of the biggest tech IPOs ever and resets how every AI company gets valued from here.

topics.title: Anthropic launches Claude Duet, a proactive AI agent that checks in on you first
topics.why: It's an early look at AI acting like a coworker that messages you, not just one you have to prompt.

topics.title: DHS orders DeepSeek banned from U.S. federal agency systems
topics.why: It's the clearest sign yet that Chinese AI tools are getting locked out of government tech, with ripple effects for enterprise buyers.
